page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with centred numbered headings (III., IV., V.) and italic references at paragraph ends. Running head at top right. Page number at top left. No margin notes.

main_text.p: comparantes quæstiones, distinctiuncularum venatores, pusillarum quarundam artium æmulatores, litigatores & iurgiorū confarcinatores. Ob hanc artem efferentes se Sophistæ infelices, canoris quibusdam suis nugis garrientes, cùm in nominum delectu & certa dictionum compositione & connexione tota vita laborant, cicadis apparent loquaciores. &c. Eodem lib.

Hi sunt lupi rapaces, tecti pellibus ouium, plagiarii, & discerti animarum abigei, qui clam quidem furantur, sed fures esse conuincuntur, qui & dolo & vi nos conantur superare qui non delectamur superuacaneis, utpote quòdminùs eis in dicêdo valeamus. Isti sunt q[?] funiculos trahunt, inquit Scriptura, & nihil texunt, inanem laborem plurimi facientes, quem impostu-ram & astutiam ipse vocauit Apostolus, aptam ad erroris insidias. Eodem libro.
Ipsæ Sophistarum dictiones non solùm multorum oculos perstringunt & eos seducunt: sed nonnunquam etiam vim adferentes, caducam reportant victoriam. Eodm libro.

Mendaces sunt revera, non ii qui se demittunt & se accommodant propter œconomiâ salutis, neq; qui labetur in aliquibus ex iis quæ sunt singularia: sed qui concidûr in iis quæ sunt vel maximè principalia, & Dominum quidem, quan-

page.notes: Line 'Isti sunt q' ends in an abbreviation mark I could not read with certainty; marked [?]. 'dicêdo' and 'concidûr' are read from a faint scan and may be misprinted. Long s is read as s throughout ('pufillarum' and 'fuperuacaneis' printed with long-s form, transcribed as pusillarum and superuacaneis). Reference 'Eodm libro.' is printed as shown, with a probable missing e.
